observation_selection: The manifest final_cohort references the final sequential cohort at source_commit; review.final_outputs binds each role and query ordinal to the final stdout member. Exactly one completed run per query per role is recorded.
field_policy: Semantic names are corrected to source meaning. Absent or unreported fields are null and listed in omitted_fields. No field value implies actual worker count unless its source key explicitly measures workers.

source_field_keys.input_path: output.fields[native_vortex_input_binding_sources] or predeclared plan.input.path when the output omits binding
source_field_keys.physical_native_scan_projected_or_read_c: no matching output.fields key found among scan/read/projected column keys; null means unreported
